## XPG ATOM 50 PCIe Gen4 x4 M.2 2280 Solid State Drive

Enjoy smoother PC performance with the XPG ATOM 50. Get ahead with sustained read/write speeds of up to 5,000/4,500 MB per second on the latest Intel or AMD platforms.

Features Ordering Information ● R/W speed up to 5,000/4,500MB/s for PC/laptop

● Work with PS5

| ● Compliant with NVMe 1.4 | 2TB | AATO-50-2TCI | 842243025972 |

● Capacity up to 2TB
